_validationCommand: npx tsx ../../../../docs/v25/reports/S16_OWNER_INPUTS/tools/validate-owner-inputs.mts spec <file> (from the pipeline dir; expected to FAIL while placeholders remain)
_cellsNote: The validator's minimum diagnostic factorial: {55-XH, 56S-H, 56S-XH} × {both stacks} = 6 cells (55-H optional). This isolates the prompt-stack effect and the model×stack interaction (effectsReport computes the difference-in-differences).
_precisionNote: The validator requires declared primary endpoints before execution. The diagnostic's job is EFFECT estimation (stack, model, model x stack difference-in-differences with cluster bootstrap CIs); at diagnostic N these rare-defect endpoints will report 'unproven at this sample size' (PRECISION_STATEMENT) — declared for honesty, not as claims.
